Harvesting can turn up Mystery Eggs. More chickens, better odds; the egg's colour follows your breeds. Rarer colours hold better prizes.

Harvests can sprout a rare sapling of a tree inside: a Rainier Cherry from cherry trees, a Honeycrisp from apple trees... Rare trees pay half as much again. The more of a tree you keep here, the likelier its sapling.

All vehicles share one tank of %d. Each plot a vehicle works uses 1 fuel (the Combine 3). The tank refills by itself, 1 fuel every %d minutes, and a spare tank is opened when it runs dry.
The Queen Bee lives here. Worker bees join while you harvest flowers, up to %d. Each bee makes honey daily.
This hive needs a Queen Bee before worker bees will join. One may turn up while harvesting flowers, or buy one.
